$description: Nesty: Doll Sort design tokens v4. Source of truth for colors, type, spacing, radii, shadows, layout, motion, sound and haptics. Keys under dollColor match nesty_core DollColor ids.

color.$m74: m7-4: every colour the frames draw now has a name. The game-side AppColors names are used as-is. streakCard* are the frame values of the peach card (the game sampled #FFF2E6 → #FFE7D0 / #E6B79A); divider is #F0DFC4 (sampled #F0E0C4).

canvas.use: every cream page (rival select, Chapters, Records, Settings); full screen height

dollColorDerivation.gamut: reduce chroma by 8% steps until inside sRGB
dollColorDerivation.note: Use for any color outside the table above.

display.source: Google Fonts (OFL). Bundle the TTFs; the game is offline-first.

icon.source: Apache 2.0. Bundle the font or export the listed glyphs as SVG.

mono.use: design annotations only, not in the app

scripts.$note: m7-4 (9.1). Fallback per glyph: Latin letters and digits stay Fredoka / Nunito; the script face draws only its own script

deva.lineHeight: multi-line ≥ 1.5 (body) / 1.3 (titles); single-line boxes keep their height and never clip ascenders

shadow.pressedTravel: buttons move down by (edge − 2) px and the solid edge shrinks to 2 px, 80 ms

familyCounter.lottieWidth: ui_family_counter is authored at 70 wide. For another width w: ValueDelegate.rectangleSize(['**', 'pill_rect'], value: Offset(w, 26)), the same for glow_rect, and ValueDelegate.transformPosition(['icon'], value: Offset(−w / 2 + 14, 0)). The count text is the game’s own

glassCaseTall.lockSymbol: 12 dp, ink, centred at caseTop + 0.898 × caseHeight
glassCaseTall.use: a case whose doll is size 5 or 6 (h > 117.5); smaller dolls keep glassCase
glassCaseTall.lottie: fx_glass_unlock_tall with doll_size and case_size set to h / 150

board.iceOverlayTop: plankTop + 16.5 − overlay height (160 → plankTop + 9 − 152.5 as before; 168 on threeShelvesTall, where fx_ice plays at scale (1, 1.05) from the ice bottom)
board.overlays: glass, tall glass and ice scale with the stand (standScale) about their bottom centre; tall glass capped at pitch − 2; adjacent ice may overlap up to 3 dp (as rows of 4 do today)
board.glassCaseTopOverlap: keep: the 0.7 dp under the plank above is inside the plank shadow

layout.towerSilhouettes: each buried nest drawn behind the top as the wood-grain blank board/doll-silhouette.svg (same for every skin), height (topHeight + 18 × depth), with a +N walnut tag at the stand's right

boardFit.$description: Replaces the stand-in clamp (h·2/3 ≤ minPitch − 8/3). One factor k per level, computed in 390×844 dp before the board scales to the screen, applied to every doll so the sizes keep their ratios. Checked against every skin: the art box above the base (742/768 of the art) covers each skin's topper, and the widest painted part is 411 of 512 art px.

limits.vertical: (pitchY − plankHeight − standSurfaceOffset − headroom) / drawnHeight, pitchY = the smallest step between plank tops
limits.hud: (planksY[0] − standSurfaceOffset − hudClearY) / drawnHeight; hudClearY = the family counter's bottom (142) + 8
limits.horizontal: (min(standWidth, pitch) − neighbourGap) / bodyWidth, for the row with the smallest pitch

boardFit.rule: k = min(1, min(vertical, hud, horizontal) / heightOf(maxSize)), heightOf from dollHeightBySize; every doll is heightOf(size) × k
boardFit.pickLift: the picked doll keeps its 14 dp lift and may pass in front of the plank above; draw it above the planks until it lands

boardPresets.$description: NestyBoard presets (prototypes/NestyBoard.dc.html scenes in brackets). Measurements in dp at 390×844. dollHeights are per maxSize after layout.boardFit; limits are its three limits for 4 slots per row.

threeShelves.use: maxSize ≤ 5 (size 5 from L71). With maxSize 6 it would shrink every doll to 90.6 %, so size-6 levels use threeShelvesTall

threeShelvesTall.use: maxSize 6, the super hard levels L130, L140 … L200. Planks 12 dp higher, 6 dp longer pitch; bottom plank ends 6 dp above the booster bar

fourShelves.use: optional variety for chapters 8–10, maxSize ≤ 4 (16 slots)
fourShelves.pieces: glassCase and ice scale with k (dolls) about the stand surface

rowOfFive.use: optional rows of 5 slots; also the +1 Slot pad when every shelf already holds 4

towerStack.$description: Buried-nest silhouettes (towerSilhouettes) that stay clear of the HUD and the plank above.
towerStack.rule: step = min(18, (hRoom − topHeight) / N), hRoom = (towerSurface − limit) / drawnHeight, towerSurface = plankTop − 17.7, limit = hudClearY on the top shelf, else the plank above's top + 40 + headroom; if step < 9, draw max(1, floor((hRoom − topHeight) / 9)) silhouettes at step 9
towerStack.tag: the +N tag always shows the real depth
towerStack.d21: true sizes, each base raised by step: top_i = towerSurface − i × step − h_i × drawnHeight; choose step (≥ 9, else fewer silhouettes) so min(top_i) ≥ hudClearY (8 dp under the counter)

icedTower.tag: hidden while the ice is on; pops in (motion.tagPop) when fx_ice plays shatter
icedTower.silhouettes: kept inside the ice: limit = max(limit, iceTop + 8)

extraSlot.placement: the lowest shelf with the fewest slots, at its right end; a first pad on a 4-4-4 board makes the bottom row 5 (rowOfFive), a second goes to the next shelf up (4-5-5); a row of 6 only when every row already holds 5 (pitch 62, stand 59.6 × 22.5)

sound.format: SFX: 44.1 kHz mono 16-bit WAV. Music and jingles: 44.1 kHz stereo OGG Vorbis q4. All in design/audio; rules in design/audio/AUDIO.md.

home.screens: Splash, Home, Daily, Museum, Shop, Skin detail, Settings

theme.$description: Chapter themes (spec §12.4). art: portrait SVG, 1290×2796, important content inside the centred 1080×1920 safeArea; the app draws it at the screen width, top-aligned. palette: this chapter's UI accents. accentTop → accent is the vertical gradient of chapter-coloured surfaces (the chapter ribbon 4.7, the Chapters card header and progress fill), accentEdge is their solid bottom edge and text shadow (0 2px 0), onAccent is the Fredoka text on them, soft + ink are a tinted chip and its text (7:1 or better), band is the art's flat top band (behind the HUD and status bar, and the fill shown while the art loads). thumb: the Shop theme card crop (7.7) in art px, at the card's 158:74 ratio; cut it from the art and draw it at 158×74 dp. figurine: the family the chapter awards (museum/).
